status: DRAFT, not filed. Filed only when the plan is final, the rule's edge cases are rerun as CPU tests of src/commute/revival_kv.py, and this file is committed with status 'filed <date>' before stage 0. The run refuses a DRAFT.
experiment: E55 C3: pruning revival, reverse fine-tuning and the possession probe (reference) on E58's twelve open-pair 67M states, beside E58's r, stand-in ratio, steering S, carry x and update size
windows: experiments/open_pair/results/large/amend1/windows_rank1_trained.pt: 'train' for reverse fine-tuning; 'heldout' (75 windows) for reading, fit half = even indices, score half = odd (steering.Task.part)

constants.reverse_recipe: finetune.finetune_arm_a unchanged: Adam, lr anchors.FT_LR = 3e-5, batch 32, grad clip 1, kl_lambda 1, steps 300, seed = the state's seed, o_token = the rank-1 table
constants.reverse_checkpoints: keydep.CIPHER_CHECKS = 1..30, 100, 300; plus a read at step 0

constants_sources.prune_k: C1b's K 5 and 15 of 4,608 MLP units scaled to the 67M's 12,288 (0.11%, 0.33%); departure stated
constants_sources.D_min_logodds: chosen here as a zero-denominator guard, about 1/10 of the smallest expected drop; no effect unless a pole state falls under it, which is then reported
constants_sources.reverse_recipe: E54's forward recipe unchanged (departure from Jain et al.'s lower reverse rate stated in the plan, section 9)
constants_sources.noise_floor: R: C1b's random-removal spread (<= 0.05); s: the checkpoint granularity
constants_sources.gap_mult: E51's separation rule and C1b's 3 sd convention
constants_sources.bands: thirds of the copy-to-cipher axis; chosen here, no source; worked on the five known columns before filing

definitions.l(m): mean over windows of log-odds of the window's rank-1 value at the answer position under model m (steering.logodds_at)
definitions.D: l(W0) - l(state) on the score half
definitions.R: max over K of [(l(top-K pruned) - l(state)) - mean over 20 random K-unit removals of (l(random pruned) - l(state))] / D; units = 4 x 3072 MLP neurons, zeroed at site mlp<l> at every position; top-K by Alg. 3's grad . w on up_proj row j (+ bias if any) of the rank-1 value's cross-entropy at the state, fit half; void if D < D_min_logodds
definitions.s: first checkpoint at which eval_arm_a's p_o (arithmetic mean P(rank-1 value), all 75 held-out windows) >= W0's p_o on the same windows; 0 -> void; never -> 301
definitions.q: per map, max over lens blocks of mean over the map's trained-key held-out windows of [log P_lens(own value) - mean over the map's other distinct values of log P_lens(value)]; P_lens at block l = W0's final norm + unembedding on the residual after block l; W0 only
definitions.p: (mean_elicit - mean_cipher) / (mean_copy - mean_cipher), seed means over non-void seeds
definitions.p_rank1ref: the same with rank-1 in place of copy; reported only

rules.reference_gap: noise = max within-map seed range (max - min) over copy, cipher, elicit, floored per noise_floor; gap = mean_copy - mean_cipher; 'ok' iff d * gap >= gap_mult * noise (d = +1 for R and q, -1 for s); 'reversed' iff -d * gap >= gap_mult * noise; else 'no gap'. Undirected baseline columns (update size, D) use |gap|.
rules.side: only when gap 'ok': 'VPD' iff p >= vpd_min; 'label' iff p <= label_max; else 'between'. Ties go to the outer band; p > 1 -> 'VPD', p < 0 -> 'label'.
rules.firm: the side holds only if p of every single-seed triple (elicit_i, cipher_j, copy_k; non-void seeds) lies in the same band; a triple with zero denominator counts as outside; else the side reads 'between'.
rules.void: a map with fewer than 2 non-void seeds makes the column 'void'
rules.verdict: over R and s: 'shared' iff both 'VPD'; 'VPD alone' iff both 'label'; else 'not settled', naming each

edge_cases_run.empty_pool: a pole map with < 2 non-void seeds -> column void; rank-1 is void for R and s by design and is not a pole
edge_cases_run.zero_denominator: gap 0 -> 'no gap'; a zero-denominator triple -> not firm
edge_cases_run.discrete_s: identical seeds -> range 0 -> floor 1 step; capped -> 301

worked_known_columns.carry_x: gap 0.822 >= 3 x 0.132; p 0.378; triples 0.310-0.440 -> between (reported column)

do_nothing.zero_update: D = 0 exactly; R void; s = 0, void

positive_controls.prune_importance_W0: sign -1, K 13 and 40: top-K lowers l(W0) below the random mean by >= 3 sd at some K; miss -> pruning void (C1b's rule)
positive_controls.reverse_elicit_s0_first: P(rank-1 value) at step 30 > at step 0 and the criterion is met before the cap; miss -> stop
positive_controls.lens: block-4 lens equals W0's log-softmax at the answer position within lens_tol; miss -> probe void

C0.claim: Stage 0 passes: sha256 of states and windows, identical window tokens across maps, G within G_tol, zero update exact, importance pruning, lens, elicit_s0 reverse first, weights back at W0 after every reverse run
C0.on_miss: stop rows exit 1 (sha256, tokens, G, zero update, reverse first, weights); void rows continue

P1.claim: each new instrument reads the copy-vs-cipher pair
P1.blind_to: R: attention changes (29-31% of each update's squared norm, E56) and changes spread over > 40 neurons; s: below one step, and structure vs distance from W0 (D reported)

P2.claim: pruning puts the elicit map on VPD's side

P3.claim: reverse fine-tuning puts the elicit map on VPD's side
P3.described_not_scored: if p_s and p_D share a band, the reading is described as possibly distance

ref_probe.claim: reference only: cipher q within +-0.5 nats, elicit q >= 1, rank-1 q >= elicit; p_q reported
